name: Anaheim Kaiser Permanente Farmers' Market
tagline: Kaiser Permanente Farmers Market in Anaheim, CA
description: Anaheim Kaiser Permanente Farmers' Market gathers local farms and food producers in 3440 E. La Palma Ave., CA. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
